aA4gvtVAjD.name: changelog (copy & paste)
aA4gvtVAjD.message:
__Huthut's Revival, Update 1__
+ new **rare bat** (ancient bat), 1/8 chance to obtain
+ added more magma in bottom left corner of map
+ added **crowbar** (for all u ogs out there)
* increased minigun's ammo amount by 200 (450)
* buffed sg's recoil by 12% (price increased to 2500)
* made sniper shoot bullets along with having recoil
